entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm not sure what to do. I have this VeloBand Pulse thing, and it's just not working. I got it for Christmas, and I'm so confused by it all.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, can I get your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Maria Flores. The order number is... VF88-6-2-1-0.

Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 24th. Now, to make sure I get you to the right place, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, it's a fault. It's definitely defective. The main reason I got it was to track my heart rate on my phone, but it just won't sync. I've tried everything in the little booklet, but nothing happens. I think the device is broken.
I understand. It sounds frustrating when a new device doesn't work as expected. So the core problem is that the band won't sync its data to your phone.
Exactly. I'm not very technical, and I'm just overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just send it back at this point.
Of course, Maria. I can definitely check our return options for you. One moment while I pull up the policy information for your account.
Okay, I've got it here. Let's see... looking at your delivery date of December 24th, it's been 27 days. Our policy states a 90-day return window for items in their original condition.
Oh! So I can return it? I thought I might have waited too long.

Not at all. You're well within the 90-day period. Since you're saying the item is defective, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.
Wow, that's such a relief! Thank you, Isaac. I was so worried. That's a perfect solution.

You're very welcome, Maria. I've just sent that email with the shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
